name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD)
description: Automatically synchronizes watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD). When a movie is watched in 4K, the HD version is also marked as watched (and vice versa). Uses IMDB, TMDB and TVDB identifiers to match media between libraries.

versions.changelog: Initial release with automatic sync and scheduled task

name: JellyTag-Plus
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language, collections) on media posters and thumbnails
description: JellyTag-Plus automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails. Supports per-library badge type controls, resolution, HDR, video codec, audio, alphabetized language flags with undetermined fallback, VOST indicator, and multiple regex-matched collection badges with custom images.

versions.changelog: Final Jellyfin 10.11-supported JellyTag-Plus release. Fixes overlay fallback handling when a bad image cannot be rendered and lets the cache warmer skip a repeatedly failing image variant instead of retrying it forever.
Fix overlay fallback handling when a bad image cannot be rendered and let the cache warmer skip a repeatedly failing image variant instead of retrying it forever.

name: Task Grid
overview: Shows Jellyfin scheduled tasks on a weekly hour grid
description: Task Grid displays Jellyfin scheduled tasks on a Monday-first weekly grid with hour columns, color coding, heavy-task overlap warnings, refresh support, and red warnings for tasks most recently aborted by server shutdown.

versions.changelog: Show Task Grid in Jellyfin's custom sidebar Extensions section, add native Jellyfin task scheduler links, and add recently used color shortcuts beside each task color selector.
